headline: Midland County Power Backup Report
summary: Homes in Midland County face a long outage about once every 15 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 28% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 47 hours. In May 2024, 7% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 16 hours. One Core lasts about 18 hours in January. One Core lasts about 37 hours in April. Two Cores are suggested. Two Cores cover 90% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
